businessGoal: Enable users to search for specific content within the application

scenarios.goal: User successfully performs a search with a valid keyword
User performs a search with an invalid keyword and receives no results
User receives appropriate feedback when no search keywords are entered

clarifications: The acceptance criteria do not specify what happens when the user performs a search with an empty keyword.

manual.reason: The story involves a user interaction with the search function.

api.reason: The business behavior of search can be validated through API capabilities.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria involve direct user interaction and visible results on the UI.
